notes: Born 11 Jun 1945 at Portland, Oregon (public-records index; Ed Simons's tree); aged 4 in the 1950 census at Richland. Married first Otho Walter Eaton, whom she divorced in Franklin County on 13 Feb 1970, and then George Coomes; lived at Pasco and Burbank; died 28 Nov 2011 at Kennewick, aged 66, as Betty A. Coomes (divorce index; death index; obituary index).
She had no children of her own; she and her first husband adopted a daughter, Mary Jane (Ed Simons, 2026).
